newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong exchange to trade Phila currency options.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong exchange to trade Phila currency options.

text.p: The Hong Kong Futures Exchange (HKFE) and the Philadelphia Stock Exchange said Friday they would cooperate to trade currency option products and create a platform for their trading in Asia.

Currency traders would be able to trade Philadelphia exchange currency options during the Asian day on the HKFE, said Nicholas Giordano, president and chief executive of the U.S. bourse, said on Friday.
He told the PHLX-HKFE International Currency Options Symposium in Hong Kong he expected the products to be tradable in Hong Kong by the end of 1996.
Trades consummated on the Hong Kong Futures Exchange would be cleared by Options Clearing Corp in Chicago, said Ivers Riley, chief executive of the Hong Kong exchange.
He added that the exchange was in the process of introducing New York Mercantile Exchange gold and petroleum futures but gave no other details.
